name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section V – Court of Auditors
part_text:
The European Parliament approves how the European Court of Auditors spent its 2024 budget of about 186 million euros. The report is mostly a set of opinions and requests, not new law. Parliament asks the Court to be more open with prosecutors, to publish clearer performance data, to fix the low number of women in senior jobs, and to join the transparency register. It also asks the European Commission to give the Court full access to its spending databases.

- Parliament signs off the Court's 2024 spending; no new rules are created.
- The Court is asked to improve ethics, gender balance and transparency.
- The Commission is urged to open its databases to the Court.
